name: Lohegaon
civicNote: The remaining part of Lohegaon was formally merged into PMC on 4 Oct 2017.
summary: A neighbourhood in north-east Pune best known as the site of Pune airport, lying between Vishrantwadi, Viman Nagar and Wagholi.
knownFor: Indian Air Force Station Lohegaon (2 Wing), established in 1939
connectivity: Road to Wagholi connects to the Pune-Ahmednagar highway
Roads from Vishrantwadi, Dhanori and Wadgaon Sheri meet here, with access to Alandi Road
suits: Buyers wanting housing close to the airport and the north-eastern suburbs.
